# Document processing fixtures

`reference.html`, `text.pdf`, `scan.pdf`, `scan.png`, `native-template.pptx`, `office.docx`, and `sheet.xlsx` contain synthetic content generated by `tests/helpers/document-fixtures.py`. The script pins its Python dependencies and does not use application data.

`korean.hwpx` was generated locally with Kordoc 4.24.80 `markdownToHwpx` from synthetic Korean headings, a contents list and a paragraph.

`nested.hwp` is Kordoc's public `tests/fixtures/textbox-nested/textbox-nested.hwp` regression fixture from https://github.com/chrisryugj/kordoc (MIT project). It tests HWP text boxes, not visual fidelity or confidential business data.

The generated presentation includes a native chart, image, master and layouts. These fixtures test extraction and source preservation, not complete PowerPoint rendering fidelity.

`reference-materials.pptx` is generated by `tests/helpers/reference-fixture.py` from the synthetic native template. It adds an editable grouped flow diagram and a nested image for source-location and reuse tests.

`reference.md` is synthetic UTF-8 CommonMark/GFM input with headings, tasks, tables, code, references and deliberately inert HTML/remote-image text. It is byte-sensitive parser input and is excluded from document formatting. It never requires fetching linked resources.
